question: If sin(90° - A) = 3/5, then what is the value of tan A?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

⇒ sin(90° − A) = cos A

⇒ cos A = 3/5

⇒ Think 3-4-5 triangle → sin A = 4/5

⇒ tan A = sin A ÷ cos A = (4/5) ÷ (3/5)

⇒ tan A = 4/3

**∴ Answer = 4/3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** sin(90° − A) = 3/5

**Formula:** sin(90° − A) = cos A

 
 Base = 3 Perp = 4 Hyp = 5 

⇒ cos A = 3/5

⇒ sin A = √(1 − cos²A)

⇒ sin A = √(1 − 9/25) = √(16/25) = 4/5

⇒ tan A = sin A ÷ cos A

⇒ tan A = (4/5) ÷ (3/5) = 4/3

**∴ Final Answer = 4/3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Complementary Identity:** sin(90° − A) = cos A and cos(90° − A) = sin A

**Pythagorean Identity:** sin²A + cos²A = 1

**tan Formula:** tan A = sin A ÷ cos A

**Standard Triangle:** 3-4-5 triangle is commonly used for quick trig evaluation
